Hi Elena — thanks for the list; helpful. Quick technical summary that should help your security and legal teams evaluate options:

Short answer on PHI: Redwood supports PHI only under contract and with deployments that provide the required isolation and controls. The recommended paths are:

1) Private deployment (VPC or on-prem package) — full PHI support. Data plane remains in your VPC or on-prem environment, customer-controlled KMS/HSM is available, audit logs retained per agreement. This is the cleanest path for regulated workloads.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity in our cloud with tenant isolation) — can be configured for PHI if:
   - Contract (BAA) is in place,
   - Data plane encryption keys are customer-managed (if required), and
   - Egress and retention settings are contractually restricted.

3) Hosted public API (multi-tenant) — not recommended for PHI by default. We can discuss a limited exception if the customer and legal accept additional mitigations, but our standard stance is that PHI should not be routed through multi-tenant endpoints.

SOC and certifications: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our production inference control set (effective audit period ending 2027-12-31). I can share the SOC attestation via our secure portal (link in related_links) after NDA if needed. We also have GDPR controls and a data processing addendum template.

Vendor questionnaire approach:
- I’ll answer the technical sections in the attached questionnaire and mark items that require legal or SOC artifacts.
- For any controls that require configuration (kms, audit retention, IP allowlist), we’ll note the required customer inputs and estimate the config lead time (~3–10 business days depending on environment).

Action items (from our side):
- Neha: populate technical answers to MedPath_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf and return by EOD Thu 7/5.
- Markus: route the draft BAA to legal and coordinate signatures.
- Priyom: share procurement checklist and draft SOW template.

If helpful, I can do a short technical walkthrough on Thursday 7/5 at 10am PT to show what changes between Dedicated and Private deployments look like in the console.
